findings.quote: the startup log from step 5 names the file on the line beginning Generated new web API auth_token, written to
findings.problem: The step 5 sample log elides startup lines with '...' and never shows this line. A reader who changed data_dir has no example to match against. They also can't tell that the line only appears on the first start, when the token is generated. On later restarts it may be absent, and they would have no way to find the token file.
findings.suggestion: Show the 'Generated new web API auth_token, written to ...' line in the step 5 sample output, and say it is logged only on first start. Also say where to look (the data_dir setting or web_api.token_file) if the line isn't there.

summary: A Quickstart that installs Hassette with uv, configures a token and base URL in .env, writes a one-file app, runs it, checks it with the hassette CLI, and opens the web dashboard. The steps are mostly clear and each has verification output.
